children: atNorth has appointed NRC Group Finland, a company wholly owned by NRC Group ASA, to a contract for the construction of a datacentre substation in Kouvola, Finland.
The contract is valued at approximately EUR 25 million, and the work will commence immediately and is scheduled for completion in May 2028.

This project is another important step in strengthening our civil business in Finland. Winning our sixth contract in the data center segment demonstrates both the strength of our core competencies and our ability to successfully expand into new and attractive markets.

It demonstrates that our disciplined approach to selecting projects that align with our strategy is yielding results and positioning us for continued profitable growth, says CEO Anders Gustafsson, NRC Group ASA.
For further information, please contact: Åsgeir Nord, CFO of NRC Group, + 47 957 34 985.

This information is subject to disclosure under the Norwegian Securities Trading Act, §5-12. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-09-10 09:46 CEST.
This stock exchange announcement was published by Charlotte Krog, Communication, NRC Group ASA.

title: NRC Group ASA - Appointed to a civil contract in Finland - EUR 25 million
